name: econsim-pro
description: EconSim Pro — CBSE Economics (030) Class XI/XII interactive simulator, data labs and concept explorers. Static HTML/CSS/JS, no bundler.

scripts.typecheck: for f in js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'typecheck OK: all js/*.js files parse'
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.vlab:typecheck: for f in vlab/*.js vlab/src/**/*.js vlab/tools/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'typecheck OK: all vlab/**/*.js files parse'
scripts.vlab:verify: npm run vlab:typecheck && npm run vlab:lint && npm run vlab:test && npm run vlab:build && npm run vlab:smoke
